desc: Derive the complete case breakdown based on how many of the four selected side elements equal the middle value.
Formulate efficient counts for invalid selections involving a competing value with equal or greater frequency.
Design prefix/suffix frequency-map updates and aggregate statistics for O(n) processing.
Verify the implemented formulas by actually running provided samples and exhaustive brute-force tests on small arrays, including all-equal, all-distinct, and repeated-value edge cases.
Implement the resulting formula in the provided Python `Solution` class with modulo handling.
